spec.name: Daily reversal
spec.notes: Daily reversal on a few hundred names: buy yesterday's losers, sell the winners.

claim.text: Research-period backtest: Sharpe 2.7, annual return 10%, maximum drawdown 4%.

verdict.opinion: The strategy exhibits signs of selection bias. The research log indicates that the submitted strategy was chosen from a set of 36 distinct specifications (best_of: 2). While the strategy logic is a standard mean-reversion signal, the performance metrics are likely inflated due to the selection process across multiple trials. Given the lack of out-of-sample validation or rigorous testing documentation, I am restricting this to paper trading to verify if the 2.7 Sharpe ratio holds under live market conditions before committing real capital.
